keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «맥스가 개미만큼 작아진다(문제)» 와 «마지막 한 방울을 마시고 다시 커진다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Max becomes as small as an ant) and the solution (he drinks the last drop and is big again). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Max, a friendly ant, a bee, and a spider
Max drinks from a tiny bottle and becomes as small as an ant.
An ant takes him back to the bottle, and he drinks the last drop to be big again.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why does the grass look like a forest?
opts: Max is as small as an ant.
The grass grows very tall in one day.
evs: Whoosh! He is as small as an ant!
Max finds a tiny bottle in the garden.
Then a friendly ant gives him a ride.
Now Max is always kind to ants.
why: 맥스가 개미만큼 작아졌어요. 그래서 풀이 숲처럼 커 보여요.
Max is as small as an ant, so the grass looks as big as a forest.

qs.q: "Then a friendly ant gives him a ride." What does "gives him a ride" mean?
qs.qko: «gives him a ride» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: A big bee flies by, and a spider looks at him!
The grass looks like a forest.
They go back to the bottle.
why: 개미와 맥스가 함께 병이 있는 곳으로 가요. «gives him a ride» 는 맥스를 태워서 데려다준다는 뜻이에요.
The ant and Max go back to the bottle together. "Gives him a ride" means the ant carries him.

qs.q: How does Max become big again?
opts: He goes back to the bottle and drinks the last drop.
He sleeps in the grass all night.
evs: A big bee flies by, and a spider looks at him!
They go back to the bottle.
Max drinks the last drop, and pop! He is big again.
Max finds a tiny bottle in the garden.
why: 개미와 함께 병으로 돌아가서, 마지막 한 방울을 마셔요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
They go back to the bottle, and Max drinks the last drop. You need both sentences.

ends: Max finds a growing potion and becomes as tall as a tree.
맥스가 커지는 물약을 찾아 나무만큼 커진다.
Max visits the ants' home under the ground.

write.src: “I can’t <u>walk through the tall grass</u>, but I can <u>ride on an ant</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «할 수 없는 일 + 대신 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you can’t do and what you can do instead in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: 두 칸 모두 «하는 일» 낱말로 시작하게 써 보세요. (예: play soccer, draw a picture)
write.moreEn: One more step: start both blanks with an action word. (e.g. play soccer, draw a picture)

img.cover: Tiny Max, a boy with short spiky orange hair, freckles, a blue T-shirt and green shorts, rides on the back of a big friendly black ant through grass blades as tall as trees, while a huge fuzzy bee flies overhead and a tiny glass bottle with a cork stands in the distance.

scenes.1: Tiny Max, a boy with short spiky orange hair, freckles, a blue T-shirt and green shorts, stands among grass blades as tall as trees and looks up with wide eyes at a giant fuzzy bee flying by, while a curious brown spider looks at him from a leaf.
scenes.2: In a sunny garden, Max, a boy with short spiky orange hair, freckles, a blue T-shirt and green shorts, is back to his normal size and kneels on the grass, smiling and waving gently at a friendly black ant on his fingertip, with a tiny empty glass bottle with a cork beside his knee.
